record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.context_brief: Triple spacing distribution for quadratic-form values
record.original_question: For a positive definite quadratic form Q on Z^2, what is the distribution of pairs (Q(x1)−Q(x2), Q(x2)−Q(x3)) with distinct xi∈Z^2? More precisely, what are the asymptotics of N_T((a,b),(c,d)) counting triples with a<Q(x1)−Q(x2)<b, c<Q(x2)−Q(x3)<d, distinct xi, and ||xi||<T?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 56 (J. Marklof ). What is the distribution of the set {(Q(x1) − Q(x2),Q(x2) − Q(x3)) : xi ∈ Z2, xi ̸= x j for i ̸= j } ⊂ R2? More precisely, determine the asymptotics of NT ((a, b), (c, d )) := # { (x1, x2, x3) ∈ (Z2)3 : a < Q(x1) − Q(x2) < b, c < Q(x2) − Q(x3) < d , xi ̸= x j for i ̸= j , ∥xi ∥ < T }.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Q:\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}$ be a positive definite quadratic form, and consider its values on the integer lattice $\mathbb{Z}^2$. For real numbers $a<b$ and $c<d$, and for $T>0$, define
$$N_T((a,b),(c,d)) := \#\Big\{(x_1,x_2,x_3)\in(\mathbb{Z}^2)^3 : a<Q(x_1)-Q(x_2)<b,\ c<Q(x_2)-Q(x_3)<d,\ x_i\neq x_j\text{ for }i\neq j,\ \|x_i\|<T\Big\},$$
where $\|\cdot\|$ denotes the Euclidean norm on $\mathbb{R}^2$. Determine the limiting distribution of the set
$$\{(Q(x_1)-Q(x_2),\,Q(x_2)-Q(x_3)) : x_i\in\mathbb{Z}^2,\ x_i\neq x_j\text{ for }i\neq j\}\subset\mathbb{R}^2,$$
that is, find the asymptotic behavior of $N_T((a,b),(c,d))$ as $T\to\infty$ (after appropriate normalization), thereby describing the triple-spacing/correlation statistics of the values of $Q$ at lattice points.
artifact.status_search_result: While pair correlation statistics for values of positive definite (and inhomogeneous) binary quadratic forms have been established by Marklof and others, triple and higher correlations remain much less understood. No published asymptotics for the triple-difference counting function described above appear in the literature, and the question is listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Pair correlation densities of inhomogeneous quadratic forms
status_evidence.snippet: Marklof established pair correlations (Poisson) for values of inhomogeneous quadratic forms on Z^2 under Diophantine conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Only pair correlations are addressed; triple correlations are not treated.

status_evidence.title: Level spacing statistics and integrable dynamics (Marklof)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses pair correlation results for quadratic form values and the Berry-Tabor conjecture; higher-order correlations are noted as open.
status_evidence.claim: Triple and higher correlations of quadratic-form values remain open.
